plaza.title: New plaza · former Chevron triangle
rows: Every point 5 m from the roadway; east side is the wall of 3970 17th St
746 m² (old station lots 680 m², curb-to-curb triangle 1204 m²)
24 stainless-steel boxes, 70 cm tall and 70 cm deep, flush with the edge, in 4 stretches of 6 with 10 cm joints; red at the corners (cut to meet the wall), purple at the openings
The point is open, plus a 5 m gap in the middle of the north and south sides
Red geraniums, orange marigolds, yellow rudbeckia, green zinnias, blue hydrangeas, purple lavender
14: four per stretch on the Market side, three on the 17th St side; parallel to the sides, facing in; slats in pride order
Abstract flowing rainbow on the blank east wall (3970 17th St), 35 m long
6.0 m: white marble basin (56 cm seat) and pedestal, then six cascading pools, largest at the bottom
Top to bottom: Red jasper · Orange alabaster · Yellow calcite · Verdite · Sodalite · Porphyry
Red jasper · Carnelian · Yellow jasper · Nephrite jade · Sodalite · Purple porphyry
Six glazed rainbow rings around the basin (purple inside, red outside), alternating with rings of the plaza stone; the paving radiates outward in hexagonal courses
Two 1.5 m marble figures holding hands, facing the Harvey Milk Plaza flag; total height 7.5 m
plaza.note: The figures are posed from the open-licence MakeHuman body; hair, wreath, ribbon and drapery are modelled for this piece.
